scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm --workspace=shared run dev" "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=server run build && npm --workspace=client run build
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=server run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=client run typecheck
